answer: The grading quorum of 3 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an farming party cannot sit on the panel that judges it. The ivory assignment is published and knoll records each panel. Shards are assigned from the kernel graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 4736 identities would post 3644 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
